guidance.source.product-analytics.query:
# Amplitude evidence

- Select the correct US/EU endpoint and project; load the project's AI Context and verify metric definitions.
- Inspect the live query_amplitude_data schema through describe_tool when progressive discovery is enabled.
- Translate the pinned analytics query into the supported segmentation/funnel/retention request.
- Keep exact dates, timezone, cohorts and counting units; preserve query/chart references in evidence.
- Use query tools only. Never manage taxonomy, create a cohort or change an experiment for research.
- Call out sampling, missing events and incomplete access. Do not fabricate a metric baseline.
- Unavailable data becomes an open question naming the owner who can provide it.
- [Official reference](https://amplitude.com/docs/amplitude-ai/amplitude-mcp)
- Mapping checked: 2026-10-18. Live project/schema conformance remains pending.

guidance.source.bi.query:
# BigQuery evidence

- Use execute_sql_readonly, never the unrestricted execute_sql tool.
- Confirm project, dataset, region and billing scope. Use a principal with read-only dataset permissions.
- Discover columns first; pin GoogleSQL, parameters, date boundaries and timezone.
- Set bounded server timeouts and inspect dry-run cost estimates before an expensive real query.
- Preserve job ID/location and poll incomplete jobs in the host; pending work is not an empty result.
- Record row limits, errors and aggregation units. Missing access becomes an explicit open question.
- Do not export sensitive raw rows merely to calculate an aggregate already supported in the warehouse.
- [Read-only tool](https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/mcp/tools_list/execute_sql_readonly)
- Mapping checked: 2026-10-18. Live IAM, cost and job-conformance checks remain pending.

guidance.docs.create:
# Confluence

- Confirm cloudId, space and parent content identity through the connected Rovo MCP schema.
- Create page content only in the requested location; retain the wholeloop ID and returned link.
- Every update uses the core read-modify-write helper: getConfluenceContent first in the same operation.
- Preserve unrelated sections and macros; transform the fetched representation, not a guessed blank page.
- Carry the fetched version into the update where the live schema supports optimistic concurrency.
- A version conflict requires another read and review; never retry a blind overwrite.
- Normalize a complete read to ref/body/revision; truncated or permission-redacted reads block writes.
- Record the returned page URL only after a successful synchronous result.
- Reference: [Official documentation](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/rovo-mcp/guides/supported-tools/)
- Mapping checked: 2026-10-18. Live page-format conformance remains pending.

guidance.source.knowledge.query:
# Confluence knowledge evidence

- Use searchConfluence with explicit CQL for Confluence knowledge; confirm space/cloud scope and fetch cited content before drawing conclusions.
- Preserve the exact query, page IDs, revision/timestamps and links; distinguish authored claims from your inference.
- Respect pagination, truncation and permissions; a partial search is not proof of absence.
- Knowledge collection is read-only: do not edit content or call destination write tools.
- Missing access or evidence becomes an explicit open question naming the owner who can answer it.
- Read the companion usage guidance for the official server reference and host-specific schema checks.
- Mapping checked: 2026-10-18. Live search/fetch conformance remains pending.

guidance.codehost.open-draft-pr:
# Github code-host operations

Use gh's own credential store; never copy tokens into files or argv.
Open only after the exact plan has human test evidence and approval. Push its
pinned commit to the named remote branch without force, then create an open draft.
Keep the named target and repository identity; do not fork or guess another remote.
Send title/body JSON through stdin to gh api, not a shell or temporary body file.
Read complete PR identity, source SHA/branch, target, draft and merged state.
A missing field is unavailable evidence, never an inferred pass or merge.
Comment only when explicitly requested; keep its idempotency key for reconciliation.
An interrupted push/create/comment has an ambiguous outcome: inspect remote state
before retrying. Never mark ready, request reviewers, merge, close or delete.

guidance.tracker.create-item:
# GitHub Issues

- Use the official GitHub MCP issues toolset; confirm the connected account/repository.
- Require explicit owner and repo. For updates include issue_number; do not infer it from a title.
- issue_write uses method create or update; issue_read uses method get.
- Keep the wholeloop ID in the body and adopt its existing link before creating another issue.
- Preserve labels, assignees and unrelated text on update. Transition only to the requested issue state.
- Record the returned html_url as the tracker link. A tool error is not publication.
- OAuth and permissions belong to the host client; do not copy credentials.
- Unsupported relationship operations remain explicit local links, not guessed MCP calls.
- Reference: [Official documentation](https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server)
- Mapping checked: 2026-10-18. Live account conformance remains pending.

guidance.tracker.create-item:
# GitLab Issues

- Use the official GitLab MCP endpoint; override its host for self-managed instances.
- Confirm the namespace and supported version; save_work_item/get_work_item replace legacy issue tools.
- Creation needs an explicit project_id (or group_id/URL), title and type_name Issue.
- Updates need the existing work item URL or work_item_iid; omit fields that are not changing.
- Resolve actual relationship types with the connected tool schema before link_work_items.
- Do not create labels or choose milestones implicitly. Keep the wholeloop ID in the description.
- Record the returned web_url; preserve a local artifact if tools or permissions are unavailable.
- OAuth is managed by the client. No credential values belong in manifests or arguments.
- Reference: [Official documentation](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/model_context_protocol/mcp_server_tools/)
- Mapping checked: 2026-10-18. Live version/account conformance remains pending.

guidance.docs.create:
# Google Docs

- Use the optional Google Workspace CLI gws and its own encrypted credential store.
- The core declares operations; the host invokes gws with argv, --params JSON and --json request JSON.
- Create returns an empty document ID; insert content using read-modify-write before reporting publication.
- Get the full document (including tabs) and revisionId before every batchUpdate operation.
- Preserve structural elements and unrelated tabs; do not flatten a rich document into guessed plain text.
- Transform the fetched document into batch requests and carry writeControl.requiredRevisionId.
- A stale revision fails; re-read and review before retrying. Never suppress writeControl on conflict.
- Normalize the complete document JSON to ref/body/revision; body is the fetched JSON representation.
- Use the returned documentId to record `https://docs.google.com/document/d/<id>/edit`.
- Native Docs MCP currently exposes read/update only, so creation uses the optional CLI.
- References: [Official documentation](https://github.com/googleworkspace/cli)
- [API reference](https://developers.google.com/workspace/docs/api/reference/rest/v1/documents/batchUpdate)
- Mapping checked: 2026-10-18. No CLI was installed; live auth/conformance remains pending.

guidance.source.support.query:
# Intercom evidence

- Confirm workspace region support and authenticate using the host-managed official MCP connection.
- Use search with object_type:conversations and explicit timestamps/filter DSL; fetch returned conversation IDs.
- Preserve the search query and starting_after cursor. A result page is not the full conversation population.
- Cite conversation links and distinguish customer reports from independently established product facts.
- Keep only necessary excerpts and omit unrelated personal data.
- Query/fetch only; do not create/update articles, send replies or change conversation state.
- Unsupported regions, missing permissions or incomplete conversation bodies become owner-assigned open questions.
- [Official MCP reference](https://developers.intercom.com/docs/guides/mcp)
- Mapping checked: 2026-10-18. Live regional/workspace conformance remains pending.

guidance.tracker.create-item:
# Jira

- Use the Atlassian Rovo MCP Jira tools and confirm cloudId/project before writes.
- Discover required issue fields and allowed transitions in the current site's tool schema.
- Carry the wholeloop ID and existing tracker key; an edit uses the existing key, never a new issue.
- Preserve unrelated description sections and field values; use the site's supported rich-text format.
- Resolve actual issue/transition/link type IDs rather than deriving them from names.
- Record the returned issue URL. Missing create/edit permission becomes a local handoff.
- OAuth belongs to the host. Never persist an API token in a manifest or fixture.
- Reference: [Official documentation](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/rovo-mcp/guides/supported-tools/)
- Mapping checked: 2026-10-18. Live site conformance remains pending.

guidance.tracker.create-item:
# Linear

- Use the official read-write Linear MCP endpoint and confirm the authenticated workspace/team.
- save_issue creates without an id and updates with the existing id; do not use retired create_issue aliases.
- Supply the real team identifier for creation and preserve the wholeloop ID in the description.
- Fetch the existing issue before editing. Preserve unrelated description and metadata.
- Resolve workflow states in the actual team before setting state; do not guess a status ID.
- Record the returned issue URL. Permissions or unavailable tools leave publication pending.
- Unsupported relationship mappings remain local; do not invent a tool name.
- References: [Official documentation](https://linear.app/docs/mcp) and [Official documentation](https://linear.app/integrations/slack)
- Mapping checked: 2026-10-18. Live account conformance remains pending.

- References: [Official documentation](https://linear.app/docs/mcp) and [Official documentation](https://linear.app/integrations/slack)

guidance.source.bi.query:

- Override the example endpoint with the actual instance before connecting; the admin must enable MCP.
- Authenticate as a read-only user and inspect permitted databases, tables and saved questions.
- Use query for read-only table/metric results; construct_query/execute_query can supply the query handle.
- Preserve database/question IDs, native query or MBQL, parameters, timezone and date boundaries.
- Follow continuation tokens and report the server's result cap rather than treating a page as all rows.
- Do not edit a saved question or create a dashboard during evidence collection.
- Cite the question/query reference and keep unavailable permissions/data as owner-assigned open questions.
- [Official reference](https://www.metabase.com/docs/latest/ai/mcp)

# Notion

- Confirm the actual parent page/data source and writable properties from fetched schema.
- notion-create-pages creates content; use an existing page ID for notion-update-page.
- Every update first fetches the full page in the same read-modify-write operation.
- Preserve unrelated content and block references; prefer a targeted edit over replacing a whole page.
- Normalize complete fetched Markdown to ref/body/revision; truncation or hidden content blocks replacement.
- allow_async false requests a synchronous write. A returned async_task is still pending: poll it in the host.
- Record the page URL only on confirmed success. The core does not equate queued work with publication.
- Discover host aliases for fetch/search; OpenAI MCP clients can drop the notion- prefix.
- OAuth stays in the client store; do not create a plaintext integration-token config.
- Reference: [Official documentation](https://developers.notion.com/guides/mcp/mcp-supported-tools)

guidance.source.knowledge.query:
# Notion knowledge evidence

- Use notion-search with a content query; fetch the matched page and preserve its citations and access limitations.
- Preserve the exact query, page IDs, revision/timestamps and links; distinguish authored claims from your inference.
- Respect pagination, truncation and permissions; a partial search is not proof of absence.
- Knowledge collection is read-only: do not edit content or call destination write tools.
- Missing access or evidence becomes an explicit open question naming the owner who can answer it.
- Read the companion usage guidance for the official server reference and host-specific schema checks.
- Mapping checked: 2026-10-18. Live search/fetch conformance remains pending.

guidance.source.bi.query:
# PostgreSQL evidence

- Use an explicit libpq service backed by a read-only database role; no password or connection URI in argv.
- Credentials come from the host's encrypted/keyring integration; never create a plaintext password file.
- The host executes the pinned query through psql stdin inside BEGIN READ ONLY and ROLLBACK.
- Reject transaction-control or multi-statement input; never permit a query to escape the read-only transaction.
- Apply a statement timeout and bounded result size; preserve schema, parameters, timezone and query digest.
- Read-only transaction semantics complement restricted role permissions; a SQL prefix check is insufficient.
- Do not grant SECURITY DEFINER side effects or broad privileges to make a failing query pass.
- Record the database/service/query reference without credentials. Errors remain owner-assigned open questions.
- [Transaction reference](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/sql-set-transaction.html)
- Mapping checked: 2026-10-18. No database connection was made; role/transaction enforcement is manual.

guidance.source.product-analytics.query:
# PostHog evidence

- Use the official MCP endpoint in tools mode; the default cli mode does not expose execute-sql directly.
- Confirm organization, project and region; discover real event/property names before authoring HogQL.
- Query through execute-sql with query:read permission, never flag/experiment mutation tools.
- Pin the exact query, inclusive/exclusive timestamps, timezone, cohorts and aggregation unit.
- Preserve returned column names, sample size and truncation warnings; a missing event is not a zero count.
- Cite the project/query reference and distinguish observed rows from your interpretation.
- Authentication, failed queries, sampling or incomplete results become an open question with an answerer.
- [Official tools](https://github.com/PostHog/posthog/blob/master/services/mcp/schema/tool-definitions.json)
- Mapping checked: 2026-10-18. Live project conformance remains pending.

guidance.docs.create:
# Repository docs

- This is intentional publication of documentation, never a runtime-state store.
- Resolve the requested Markdown path under the repository docs/ directory and reject symlink escapes.
- Ask for an explicit destination if none is known. Do not invent a tracked path.
- The host maps native.read-file/write-file to its own file tools; the core never runs arbitrary shell text.
- Create exclusively, without overwriting existing content. Update only through read-modify-write.
- Preserve front matter, navigation and unrelated sections; follow repository docs conventions.
- Normalize a full UTF-8 read to ref/body/revision (content digest for local concurrency checks).
- Verify the expected digest before atomic replacement. A conflict requires a fresh read/review.
- Report the relative path and optional code-host URL; do not commit or push as a side effect.
- Native tool availability, path containment and concurrent-write behavior need host conformance.

guidance.source.errors.query:
# Sentry evidence

- Scope the official OAuth endpoint to the actual organization/project where practical.
- Use search_events for counts/aggregations and event evidence; issue groups are not event counts.
- Preserve dataset, environment, release, filters and exact time range from the measurement plan.
- Inspect the live schema: supported absolute windows and natural-language translation vary by version.
- Cite event/issue/query links and retain sample sizes or partial-result warnings.
- Do not triage, resolve issues, change alert rules or invoke automated fixes during evidence collection.
- A missing tool/provider key, permission error or unpinnable window remains an open question.
- [Official server](https://mcp.sentry.dev/)
- Mapping checked: 2026-10-18. Live search/window conformance remains pending.

guidance.source.support.query:
# Zendesk evidence

- This provider maps the official Search REST API through a host-managed curl invocation, not an invented MCP server.
- Require the actual Zendesk subdomain and a host-managed OAuth credential; never put a token in argv/config.
- Send GET /api/v2/search.json with a URL-encoded query constrained to type:ticket and explicit date filters.
- The host supplies authentication through stdin or its credential store and never echoes credentials.
- Follow pagination; split date ranges when the search cap is reached and preserve count/next-page metadata.
- Keep ticket IDs/URLs and distinguish customer statements from verified product behavior.
- Redact unnecessary personal data from evidence. Never reply to or modify a ticket during research.
- Search indexing can lag; missing records and permission failures become explicit owner-assigned questions.
- [Search API](https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/)
- Mapping checked: 2026-10-18. Live subdomain/auth normalization remains pending.
